authority: docs/owner/IDP_VALUATION_ACCURACY_DIRECTIVE_2026-10-25.md section 8 and 13 (research only; no served behaviour, flag or value changes)

provenance.shapeUse: 2025 weekly stat lines rescored under the 2026 card; used for distribution SHAPE only (model S, model P CV), never for level, rank or value
provenance.scorer: src.nfl_data.realized_points.compute_weekly_points(source='sleeper') over the league scoring_settings (Lane A: 3,710 / 3,710 within 0.01 of Sleeper players_points, 2026 wk 1-6)
provenance.lineupEligibility: src.ros.lineup.precompute_slot_eligibility (host fantasy_positions); vectorized solver pinned to src.ros.lineup.solve_optimal_assignment by tests

parameters.replacementRule: median-scoring roster among the rank 1-5 free agents per opened slot family (sensitivities: best-of, rank 1, 3, 5)

population.definition: rostered in the league, forward-available, >= 3 appearances in 2026 weeks 1-6
population.freeAgentDefinition: unrostered, forward-available, >= 2 appearances and at least one in weeks 4-6

fineResolution.source: nflverse-data rosters/roster_{2026,2025}.csv depth_chart_position (primary); Sleeper depth_chart_position only when nflverse is silent

archetypeRules.EDGE: nflverse DE, or an OLB the host also lists at DL
archetypeRules.OLB: nflverse OLB without host DL eligibility (off-ball)
archetypeRules.UNKNOWN: no nflverse or Sleeper-depth fine position; excluded from archetype statistics

verified: per-appearance event counts (2026 wk 1-6 host stat lines, scorer-verified)
points per event (the league card, fingerprint-pinned)
weekly appearance record (played / DNP / bye from host snaps + nflverse schedule)
provisionalVarianceAssumptions: E: a player's own <=6 weekly scores are his whole distribution (n-limited, bootstrap shows the cost)
S: archetype SHAPE from 2025, rescored under the 2026 card (shape only; level is the player's own)
P: gamma with archetype CV (two moments only)
Q: independent Poisson event counts at the player's own observed rates (no event stacking)
players are independent within a week (no shared game environment)
the best free-agent claim is free, unique to the claiming team and unconstested
availability = share of non-bye weeks the player appeared; no injury model

libraryVarianceAssumption.model: src.league_intel.sim_calibration.PointsModel (per-position coefficient of variation; draw = max(0, N(mean, max(0.5, mean*cv))))
libraryVarianceAssumption.note: this checkout holds no fitted sim_points_model.json, so the documented fallback constants are what the library uses here; a box-local fitted artifact would replace them

rankComparison.definition: rank within the lineup-position family (DL, LB, DB, QB, RB, WR, TE, K) by expected ppg (availability-weighted mean) versus by the best-ball marginal over the best free-agent claim; 'deterministic lineup' is the same marginal in a world where every player scores exactly his ppg every week; 'material' = rank differs by at least max(3, 10% of the group)

variants: base (median of FA ranks 1-5, observed availability, schedule byes)
injured / out players kept at historical availability

roleChange.definition: early = weeks 1-3, late = weeks 4-6; role change = |late - early snap share| >= 0.15; players need >= 2 appearances in each window

realizedCheck.definition: marginal vs the best free-agent claim on the six actual weeks (weeks 1-6, bye = 0), averaged over the 12 roster contexts; n = 6 weeks per player, in-sample, no variance model

bootstrap.note: levels, ratios and spreads: bias-corrected estimate with a 95% basic-bootstrap interval (plug-in and bias published beside it); rank agreements, shares and marginal levels vs replacement: plug-in with the percentile interval of the replicates; contrasts also carry a Bonferroni interval over their family
